summary: A homeowner asks a visiting senator to take up an insurance problem affecting other households.
realLife: Schwartz told a Senate field hearing that she wanted help for other people who had lost homes as well as for herself.
gates: A claimant has expressly asked the member to consider other households.
inGame: needs: the claimant’s request to pursue a wider policy concern.

turns.what: The office seeks testimony from other claimants.
turns.pulledBy: Other households consent to sharing their experiences.
turns.writesBack: The member has separately sourced cases to compare.

turns.what: The office opens the witness’s case first.
turns.pulledBy: Other claimants have yet to authorize contact.
turns.writesBack: The named claim proceeds on its own.
